title: Reference-adapted Gibbs duality and positive witness transfer
statement: For finite-dimensional N, fixed finite R, and a >= 1, the Gibbs exponential supremum equals the entropy-functional supremum. A violating faithful X yields the positive Gibbs input Y=exp(G_X)/Phi(X), and a violating input yields X=N(rho) with at least that objective.

requires: Finite-dimensional channel N, fixed finite reference R, parameter a >= 1, and the source-defined entropy and Gibbs functionals.
provides: Exact variational equivalence and same-channel positive input-witness transfer without a min-max interchange.
assumptions: Restrict outputs to the effective support when needed; obtain boundary states by faithful approximation.
costs: Matrix logarithms/exponentials and conditioning; no universal complexity or speed guarantee.
contract.units: Nats for entropy objectives; dimensionless state/channel parameters.
contract.obstruction: Monotone alternation can approach a singular boundary or a nonglobal stationary point; it is not a global optimality certificate.

body: The identity follows from the Gibbs formula and relative-entropy defect; data processing bounds that defect, while setting X=N(rho) gives the reverse direction. The Gibbs maximizer is an actual positive input. No min-max swap is needed.

review.scope: Finite-dimensional exact duality and positive witness transfer only; no global W3 bound or algorithmic guarantee.
